import torch
import sys

print('=== GPU Info ===')
print(f'torch={torch.__version__}, cuda={torch.cuda.is_available()}, gpus={torch.cuda.device_count()}')
for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count()):
    props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i)
    print(f'  GPU {i}: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(i)} ({props.total_memory // 1024**3}GB)')

print()
print('=== Package Versions ===')
import transformers, datasets, accelerate
print(f'transformers={transformers.__version__}')
print(f'datasets={datasets.__version__}')
print(f'accelerate={accelerate.__version__}')
try:
    import lm_eval
    print(f'lm_eval={lm_eval.__version__}')
except:
    print('lm_eval=NOT_INSTALLED')
try:
    import wandb
    print(f'wandb={wandb.__version__}')
except:
    print('wandb=NOT_INSTALLED')

print()
print('=== Load Qwen3-0.6B ===')
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/root/provenance_weight_training/models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B', trust_remote_code=True)
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('/root/provenance_weight_training/models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B', torch_dtype=torch.float16, device_map='auto', trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Qwen3-0.6B loaded: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())/1e6:.1f}M params, device={next(model.parameters()).device}')

print()
print('=== Load ModernBERT-base ===')
from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification
tok2 = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('answerdotai/ModernBERT-base', trust_remote_code=True, cache_dir='/root/provenance_weight_training/models/modernbert')
model2 = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('answerdotai/ModernBERT-base', num_labels=2, trust_remote_code=True, cache_dir='/root/provenance_weight_training/models/modernbert')
print(f'ModernBERT-base loaded: {sum(p.numel() for p in model2.parameters())/1e6:.1f}M params')

print()
print('=== Test alpha_eff module ===')
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/provenance_weight_training')
from weighting.alpha_eff import compute_alpha_eff, compute_ess, find_optimal_b, compute_sample_weights
q = torch.tensor([0.1, 0.3, 0.8, 0.9, 0.2])
b_opt = find_optimal_b(q, tau=0.9, n_min=2)
alpha = compute_alpha_eff(q, b_opt)
ess = compute_ess(q, b_opt)
w = compute_sample_weights(q, b_opt)
print(f'q_scores={q.tolist()}, b*={b_opt:.4f}, alpha_eff={alpha:.4f}, ESS={ess:.1f}')
print(f'weights={[round(x,4) for x in w.tolist()]}')

print()
print('=== Code Sync Verification ===')
import os
files = [
    'weighting/__init__.py', 'weighting/alpha_eff.py',
    'data_generation/generate_synthetic.py', 'detector/train_detector.py',
    'training/pretrain_weighted.py', 'evaluation/eval_pipeline.py',
    'evaluation/compare_results.py'
]
for f in files:
    fp = os.path.join('/root/provenance_weight_training', f)
    size = os.path.getsize(fp) if os.path.exists(fp) else -1
    status = 'OK' if size >= 0 else 'MISSING'
    print(f'  {f}: {status} ({size} bytes)')

print()
print('=== ALL CHECKS PASSED ===')
"
